connector.name: Astrocal
connector.registryDescription: AI-native scheduling: check availability, book meetings, cancel and reschedule via MCP
connector.summary: Hosted at api.astrocal.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.astrocal, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ASTROCAL_API_KEY
env.description: Your Astrocal API key (create one at https://astrocal.dev/dashboard/connect)

env.name: ASTROCAL_API_URL
env.description: Custom API base URL (defaults to https://api.astrocal.dev)

env.name: ASTROCAL_DEFAULT_EVENT_TYPE_ID
env.description: Default event type ID when not specified in tool calls
